description.value: Pizza Factory Vancouver is a franchise location of a BC pizza chain originally founded in Coquitlam in 1984 by Sam Sanghera, now with multiple locations across British Columbia. The shop makes artisan dough and sauce fresh daily in small batches, earning strong local reviews for crust quality and friendly service. It offers both walk-in and online ordering for takeout, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists on Fraser Street.
